answer.summary: A dedicated open-source tool or fork of BigBench with explicit documentation of memory state tracking and token budget-aware evaluation is not currently available in public repositories.
answer.content: No source was found that extends BigBench with explicit mechanisms for tracking memory state and measuring usage under token budgeting. The search yielded no repository with direct evidence of such functionality, confirming the absence of community-driven solutions that meet the specified criteria for controlled, transparent evaluation of memory-aware agents under token constraints. This reinforces the need for new, dedicated evaluation frameworks rather than relying on existing benchmarks without memory-aware design support.
